answer: Each new agent identity must lock 800 POA as a refundable bond on a shared knoll for 48 hours of clean activity. An attacker creating N sybils freezes 800N capital that is fully slashed if two accounts produce matching answers to the same private opal challenge within one epoch window. An honest single agent recovers the bond after the wait, so the cost is asymmetric: mass forgery requires capital linear in N while honest participation only requires patience and a sable signature of uniqueness.
